hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker v2 hook that configures asymmetric static LP fees per pool — separate rates for buying vs. selling the Clanker token — applied via `updateDynamicLPFee` on each swap. Supports an optional MEV module for elevated fees during the pool launch window and a pool extension for afterSwap callbacks. Protocol fees are taken as a delta in beforeSwap/afterSwap.
